findings.claim: Reformat leaves adjacent author lists in two styles: authors collapsed to one line with no trailing comma, maintainers kept multi-line with one.
The new TOML and import style is not enforced by any configured formatter, so the next hand edit reverts it and the churn repeats.
Cosmetic TOML reformat ships in the same diff as the breaking 3.8 drop and 3.0.0 to 4.0.0 bump, so release content cannot be isolated.
